doc.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Tommy's comic timing
summary: Banter about Tommy's comedy and timing, including Clear the Room.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: The nicknames seem to just hang on so, we have a book I’ve been reading and it has a whole chapter just about nicknames. They seem to stick really quick. Did you ever have one? You know I think, personally, that you were a comedian in another life.
It wasn’t a question, it was a strange personal observation but you said on the elevator coming up, “timing is everything.” And last night, he comes up, “Here’s a tune called ‘Clear the Room.’”
